questions.q: Select the correct indirect speech: He said to me, “I am leaving now; will you join me?”
opts: He told me that he is leaving now and asked if I would join him.
He told me that he was leaving then and asked whether I will join him.
He said me that he was leaving then and asked would I join him.
He told me that he was leaving then and asked if I would join him.
questions.why: Mixed sentences use 'told' for the statement and 'asked if' for the question; 'now' becomes 'then'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “sycophant”:
questions.why: A sycophant is a person who flatters the powerful for advantage. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: “The candidate ____ I believe is the best has been selected.”
questions.why: 'Who' is the subject of 'is'; 'I believe' is parenthetical. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “laconic”:
questions.why: 'Laconic' means using very few words; terse. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct article: “She has ____ little patience left, so she cannot wait.”
questions.why: 'Little' without 'a' means hardly any (negative); 'a little' would mean some. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “He is used to ____ up early.”
questions.why: 'Be used to' takes a gerund (to is a preposition). GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: “He is used to ____ up at five every morning.”
questions.why: 'Be used to' (accustomed to) takes a gerund. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the meaning of the idiom “Hobson's choice”:
opts: an apparent choice where there is really no alternative
questions.why: Named after Thomas Hobson: take what is offered or nothing. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct conjunction: “I would rather die ____ beg for mercy.”
Choose the correct word: “It is the best film ____ I have ever seen.”
questions.why: After a superlative, 'that' is the preferred relative pronoun. GPSC-style practice item.
